description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Witch Quick Cast], [Awoken Witch], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quartz Eye Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning)] and [Witch's Awakening] to the user

description.name: Witch Quick Cast
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Witch abilities

description.name: Awoken Witch
description.text: Witch abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Witch abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Quartz Eye Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Witch's Awakening
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning] after using two Fire/Ice/Lightning Witch abilities if the triggering ability deals Fire/Ice/Lightning damage
